video_title: Pat Bev opens up on how the Miami Heat tried to BREAK but MOLDED HIM 👀

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the intense discipline of the Miami Heat culture
quotes.excerpt: Before LeBron James got to the Heat, they didn't have a motherfucker with no headband.
quotes.quote: It's nothing I've ever experienced in basketball in my life. That Heat culture is absolutely real. Anyone who's been there, the practice facility, the locker room is downstairs, you got to go upstairs to get to the practice facility. Before you open the door to get to the practice facility, you have to have on knee pads and your jersey has to be tucked in every single time. I don't care who you is. Discipline off the rip. Before LeBron James got to the Heat, they didn't have a motherfucker with no headband. Think about it.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: How the Miami Heat culture provided necessary structure for Patrick Beverley
quotes.excerpt: It gave me exactly what I needed to get me structure, how to work.
quotes.quote: It was perfect for me because it gave me exactly what I needed to get me structure, how to work. It gave me everything I was missing. Okay, cool. I got John Lucas, this reminded me of John Lucas. Cool. I got everything I wanted. I'm in there every day, I'm working out every day, Summer League, I'm this, they molded me, got me right, got me right, got me right.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his transition from playing freely to team basketball
quotes.excerpt: Give me the ball, get out the way.

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: What you mean you didn't know how to run a team? From Chicago, Illinois, you used to, so what you saying? You so used to just getting that motherfucker to you or what?

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: I was just, give me the ball, get out the way.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the patience of his early coaches
quotes.excerpt: My coaches from high school and college were real patient with me.
quotes.quote: I don't remember plays because I don't, because I ain't, my coaches from high school and college were real patient with me. I'm used to the word patient. They were real patient with me. They were, come off this screen, you get the ball, shoot it. Any part in hand down, shoot the ball. If they hand up, go dunk on them. They made it real simple for me. When I was with the Heat, it was they want me to get the ball to the big, go to the corner, set a down screen, split action, come off, get the pick and roll. I'm forgetting plays, shit's moving fast. And Erik Spoelstra, he on my ass.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on Doc Rivers' influence on his basketball philosophy
quotes.excerpt: If I can have my players play free and not think, I'm going to get the best version.
quotes.quote: I got that from Doc Rivers. Shout out to Doc Rivers. I got that from Doc. If I can have my players play free and not think, I'm going to get the best version of them. The moment the coaching staff makes it complicated or or or put my players don't understand, they going to be a half a second behind, they ain't going to play well.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the talent level of his team in Greece
quotes.excerpt: That team was the best team to ever be put together in Europe.
quotes.quote: Right now, that team was the best team to ever be put together in Europe. That's team Josh Childress, he left the NBA, he came there. Linas Kleiza, Von Wafer, we had all the European greats. You got to think, Josh got that bankroll over there. That's what, the feeling, and that's where my first European roots kind of started there, from from from Greece. You got to think, I'm the youngest American to ever play in the EuroLeague Championship. I went to the EuroLeague Championship 20 years old.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on learning from Milos Teodosic in Europe
quotes.excerpt: I'm around Theodoros Papaloukas, the guy who beat the USA team.
quotes.quote: I'm around Theodoros Papaloukas, the guy who beat the USA team. Milos Teodosic, best passer I ever seen in Europe. He played in the NBA a little bit. You feel me? I'm playing, I'm playing with all them. So like, I'm learning, I'm learning slowly how to run a team. I'm not playing, but I'm learning slowly how to run a team.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on Ricky Rubio's impact on his development
quotes.excerpt: Ricky Rubio, he's going to be in your draft. You going to see him throughout your whole life.
quotes.quote: Ricky Rubio. Yeah, he's going to be in your draft. You going to see him throughout your whole life. I want you to take the ball from him every time. He made it real simple for me. And if you watch the game, bring it up, I took his ball every single time.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his decision to sign with the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: I made a decision to go to the Miami Heat, LeBron James, Chris Bosh.
quotes.quote: Yeah, I made a decision to go to the Miami Heat, LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Chris Bosh. What is going on? I get calls, boy you about to play with LeBron James. It's lit. It's lit. Boy you got, you about to play with LeBron James, what they got to, I'm right to be in a hotel, all the rookies meet, Dexter Pittman, you feel me? We sit there, watch the CB, they at the, they they got the jerseys popping in the Miami, the shit flying around and shit. I damn, the decision, the decision. I'm in Miami, the decision, sign, I signed already. I'm signing that motherfucker, I signed two-year contract.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the influx of talent to the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: Next thing you know, Mike Miller come there, Eddie House come there, Jamal Magloire come there.
quotes.quote: Next thing you know, Mike Miller come there, Eddie House come there, Jamal Magloire come there. Big cat, they stacking some shit. Chris Bosh come, Udonis Haslem there, Carlos Arroyo there, what I'm in there, what? James Posey there, all type of people. I'm what is going on right now, bro?
